spec_match.rationale: Probes the exact shipped surface (window.subApps + SubApps interface object, [IsolatedContext]/[SecureContext] gating) and invokes the real add()/remove()/list() members from the Chromium IDL, with the requirements banner quoting the real preconditions (permissions policy, primary top-level context).

interactive.rationale: Three buttons make genuine API calls and print the verbatim resolved/thrown/rejected outcome; the exposure probe renders live context signals (protocol, isSecureContext, crossOriginIsolated, typeof reads), and the probe can genuinely report a present state inside an IWA.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The feature index promises real invocations plus the absent-vs-ineligible distinction, and the page delivers exactly that three-state verdict.

edge_cases.rationale: Distinguishes absent-in-normal-tab (expected) from absent-inside-isolated-app (real unsupported signal) from present, and maps every DOMException name to its cause; but the present-context rejection paths (SecurityError, NotAllowedError) can only be documented, not executed, outside an installed IWA.

conformance.rationale: The new feature suite asserts the negative exposure contracts (subApps and SubApps hidden outside Isolated Contexts, absent from Navigator, policy visibility gating) that this hosted page can genuinely fail, and records IWA-only contracts as manual assertions instead of faking them.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium via CDP: desktop 1280x800 and mobile 360x740 DPR3 loads, add/remove/list buttons clicked with the TypeError outcome verified in #callResult, focus lands on native buttons, zero console errors and zero failed requests other than the environment-blocked fonts.googleapis.com stylesheet.

telemetry_health.rationale: Primary asserts (subapps-probe-exposed, subapps-real-call-ran) only fire when the API is present; the fallback branch reports separate ids (subapps-probe-fallback-honest, subapps-call-fallback-surfaced) so a fallback is never counted as a pass.

design_system.rationale: Only CSS variables are used, verdict/status panels keep charcoal-on-stone AA contrast, and no button background is overridden without its color.

accessibility.rationale: Native buttons with visible :focus-visible outlines, definition-list context readout, aria-live polite output announcing call outcomes, and aria-labels on the result pre blocks; keyboard focus verified via CDP.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: document.scrollingElement.scrollWidth equals innerWidth (0px overflow) at 360x740 DPR3 touch emulation and 1280x800; controls go full-width under 640px with min-height 2.75rem tap targets; long flag strings wrap via overflow-wrap:anywhere.

openQuestions.title: Capture the present-state truth inside a packaged IWA
openQuestions.detail: Build/install the official sample IWA (github.com/vkrot-cell/subapps-demo) in Chrome 152 with dev mode, open this probe's logic inside it, and record the real resolved list()/add() shapes and the SecurityError/NotAllowedError texts as runtime evidence. Everything present-state on this page is currently documented from Chromium source (sub_apps.cc), not executed.

openQuestions.title: Track the chrome://flags entry discrepancy
openQuestions.detail: ChromeStatus lists #enable-sub-apps but current Chromium main has no such about_flags entry; the page says so and recommends --enable-features=SubApps. Re-check a Chrome 152 stable build and update the banner if the flag ships.

guidanceConsulted.query: capability detection honest unsupported fallback messaging for gated browser API
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Gate on an explicit capability probe and show labelled unavailable states naming the exact missing prerequisite; never render fake success.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Three-state verdict (present / absent-context / absent-runtime) keyed off location.protocol and typeof window.subApps, with every real call outcome printed verbatim and mapped to its prerequisite.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive form control panel layout without horizontal overflow mobile
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use wrapping flex/grid, let wide content scroll in its own container, and break long strings so the page never scrolls horizontally.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: flex-wrap controls that go full-width under 640px, pre blocks with overflow:auto, overflow-wrap:anywhere on status/verdict text; CDP-measured 0px overflow at 360px.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible live region status updates aria-live button action result
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Prefer native elements, give every control an accessible name, and mirror async visual results in a polite live region.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Native buttons, <output aria-live="polite"> announcing each call outcome, aria-labels on raw result panels, :focus-visible outlines.

summary: Honest three-state capability probe with genuine add/remove/list invocations. Verified with headless Chromium over CDP (chrome-devtools-mcp is unavailable in this hardening environment): desktop+mobile renders, all three call buttons exercised with real TypeError outcomes surfaced and explained, zero console errors, only the sandbox-blocked Google Fonts request failed. Present-state behavior remains source-documented until an IWA run can execute it.
